text:
Recent work distinguishes functional relationships from broad semantic relevance: substitutes serve similar purposes; complements support joint use. The 2025 [LLM-enhanced complementary reranking paper](https://genai-personalization.github.io/assets/papers/GenAIRecP2025/5_Xu.pdf) demonstrates title-based relationship judgments, but these remain hypotheses rather than verified compatibility. The 2025 [intent-aware recommendation survey](https://doi.org/10.1145/3700890) emphasizes that intent changes between visits and within sessions. Consequently, a related item may still be an unhelpful next choice; similarity alone cannot establish redundancy, an unmet need, or purchase intent.

Practical diagnostic proposal: extract only explicitly stated functions, formats, entities, and compatibility claims from titles/descriptions; compare recommendations with recent history and with one another. Flag potential substitutes when stated functions overlap, potential complements when text supports joint use, and unsupported adjacent interests when topical similarity lacks functional or historical support. Record evidence spans, history support counts, missing information, and an “unknown” relationship option. Treat temporal co-occurrence as weak supervision, never proof of complementarity. Measure near-duplicate concentration separately from relevance; repeated artists, franchises, or product types need not imply unwanted repetition.

Validate these proxies against explicit qualitative feedback: ask whether each recommendation is useful now, redundant, a suitable alternative, a useful addition, or unsupported, and collect the reason. Report agreement, contradictions, and abstention coverage by relationship and dataset; do not claim validation until feedback exists. [SM-RS 2.0 (2026)](https://doi.org/10.1145/3754459) supports separately measuring perceived relevance, novelty, diversity, exploration, and serendipity. For this benchmark, qualitative diagnostics supplement the fixed macro validation HR@10 selection criterion; they cannot establish unobserved diversity preferences, conformity traits, specifications, or needs.
